materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/database snapshots were sufficient for Table 1/2, assay methods, DBAASP row reconciliation, and bounded mechanism adjudication. Supplementary assets are image/HTML-indexed context only; no local structured supplementary table or spreadsheet was present.

summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the prior worker-2 empty activity layer and worker-4 placeholder database conflicts for HBD4 analogs in PMC4364940. The paper is publication-grade with cautions for modified-cysteine database sequence normalization and bounded figure-only supplementary context.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-adjudication found source-supported LC/MFC rows in Table 2, reconciled all linked DBAASP assay rows to primary evidence, and closed the prior complete-message-test rework ticket without fabricating unsupported supplement chart values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 18 linked DBAASP assay rows match primary Table 2 or its footnotes for peptide, endpoint, target, value, unit, and citation. Sequence rows with X placeholders for Acm/tBu protected cysteines are preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than smoothed to source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Twenty-two source-supported LC/MFC records were extracted from primary XML/PDF Table 2, including HBD4 controls, three main analogs, and six footnote-only rows. No toxicity/hemolysis rows are reported in the local primary material.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is accepted with bounded strength: direct imaging supports membrane interaction/internalization, while nucleic-acid or intracellular target statements remain inferred context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplement assets are image/HTML-indexed, but local materials are sufficient for this analysis repair.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP sequence snapshots for H4-1d, H4-2d, and H4-1dΔEF use X placeholders for Acm/tBu protected cysteine positions; primary Table 1 records the modified residues.
S2 Fig provides PMF/CCCP activity context as image-only supplementary material; exact chart values were not fabricated or promoted into row-level activity records.
The paper supports membrane interaction and intracellular accumulation but does not directly identify a single intracellular molecular target.
